Further to our letter No. SEC/SE/050/2026-27 dated July 30, 2026 intimating the proposed acquisition of ST Advanced Composites Private Limited, we wish to inform you that the execution of Share Purchase Agreement between the Parties has been completed today ie., August 25, 2026 for acquiring 100% of equity shares of ST Advanced Composites Private Limited ("Target Company") for a total consideration of about Rs. 10 Crores (Rs. 1.50 Cr. to the Promoters towards acquisition of Equity Shares and Rs. 8.50 Cr. as a loan to the Target Company to enable it to settle its liabilities). 

Please find the disclosure enclosed herewith.

Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that, CRISIL Ratings Limited has upgraded the credit ratings on the bank facilities of the Company. CRISIL Ratings communication dated September 07, 2026 for assignment of Credit Rating, which was received by the Company on September 08, 2026 is enclosed.
